title: Depth vs. Info-Dumping
use_cases: Use when you want to avoid overwhelming readers with excessive detail
Implement when crafting a setting that remains coherent and believable
Configure when balancing narrative depth with pacing and clarity
Use when you need to maintain immersive storytelling without resorting to encyclopedic data
content: The trap of world-building: creating so much detail that it overwhelms both you and your readers. The goal isn't comprehensive encyclopedias—it's consistent, immersive storytelling.
